issue_request: FHIR-30891 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It reported that the Narrative Linking examples used originalText with valueUrl while originalText was string-only, and the approved resolution was to allow originalText to support both string and url while clarifying that originalText with url points to original wording encoded by the referencing element and narrativeLink does not claim derivation.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-30891-tagged implementation commit was found. The core Narrative Linking section predates the issue in commit e9f8d78996d66a0511b02dd92e6e0b60a1615da8 and already used originalText valueUrl examples; current authoritative extension source is in the FHIR Extension Pack, whose initial source already has originalText value[x] types string and url.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM 202105 minutes confirm the decision to expand originalText to both string and url. FHIR-37708 later repeated the originalText valueUrl concern and was rejected as already addressed by FHIR-30891. FHIR-37792 later refined the same narrative-linking family and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 5140d21834dfd1f1b804dcde8a10a21952b95ab5.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit.
